detail: Monitoring Agency Report - Pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with Regulation 41(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, please find enclosed the Monitoring Agency Report issued by CRISIL Ratings Limited, the Monitoring Agency appointed by the Company, in respect of the utilisation of the proceeds raised through the Initial Public Offering ( IPO ) of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
